description: B1/B2 Python baselines vs Lean verdicts on the 286-pair grid (fresh Lean batch run).

baseline_definitions.B1: single-capability requirements only, each in isolation; coupled constraints ignored; evidence status ignored (estimates and unsourced values taken at face value); missing/unknown values, unknown install status, unsupported comparisons and undecidable conditions never block; verdict NOT MET iff a documented value violates a requirement, else MET (B1 never answers NEED INFO).
baseline_definitions.B2: same per-requirement comparison as B1 (provenance ignored, coupled constraints ignored) but missing/unknown gives NEED INFO under CryoLean's three-valued verdict rule.

cause_definitions.coupled: Lean has a mandatory coupled constraint that does not pass
cause_definitions.provenance: the baseline decided a requirement from a value Lean does not trust
cause_definitions.missing: B1 let a requirement without usable data pass
